apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description:
EnvironmentCRSpec defines the desired state of an Environment.
ARCH-004: The naming collision is resolved — EnvironmentSpec was renamed to
TenantEnvironmentEntry in tenant_types.go. This type can be renamed to
EnvironmentSpec in a future cleanup if desired.

namespace.description: Namespace defines the target namespace for this environment.

name.description: Name is the explicit namespace name (e.g., "loopruntime-loopruntime-production").

networkPolicy.description: NetworkPolicy configures network isolation for the namespace.

isolate.description: Isolate enables network isolation (deny-all + allow-ingress + allow-egress).

plan.description: Plan is the tenant's subscription tier, used to determine RBAC rules.

project.description:
Project is the project segment of the canonical namespace formula
`loopruntime-<tenant>-<project>-<env>`. T3.1 of plan
2026-06-09-m2-operator-canonical-fix v1.4: when populated by the
TenantController (from TenantEnvironmentEntry.Project — which T1.1
makes required at the CRD level), EnvironmentController computes the
canonical M2 namespace from this field + Environment instead of
trusting the Namespace.Name value. Optional at the EnvironmentCRSpec
level for backward-compatibility with pre-T3.1 CRs whose namespace
was hand-set via Spec.Namespace.Name; new CRs created by the
post-T3.1 TenantController populate it unconditionally.

resourceQuota.description: ResourceQuota defines optional resource limits for the namespace.

cpu.description: CPU is the maximum CPU allowed (e.g., "8").

memory.description: Memory is the maximum memory allowed (e.g., "16Gi").

storage.description: Storage is the maximum storage allowed (e.g., "50Gi").

tenantRef.description: TenantRef references the parent Tenant CR by name.

name.description: Name is the name of the Tenant CR.

status.description: EnvironmentCRStatus defines the observed state of an Environment.

cellID.description:
CellID is the cell whose runtime cluster holds Namespace, recorded when
the namespace is provisioned. Deletion reads it so the namespace is
removed where it was created, even after the Tenant was re-pinned to
another cell or is already gone.

conditions.description:
Conditions represent the latest available observations of the environment's state.
Condition types: NamespaceReady, RBACReady, NetworkPolicyReady, QuotaReady

items.description: Condition contains details for one aspect of the current state of this API Resource.

lastTransitionTime.description:
lastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.
This should be when the underlying condition changed.  If that is not known, then using the time when the API field changed is acceptable.

message.description:
message is a human readable message indicating details about the transition.
This may be an empty string.

observedGeneration.description:
observedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon.
For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions[x].observedGeneration is 9, the condition is out of date
with respect to the current state of the instance.

reason.description:
reason contains a programmatic identifier indicating the reason for the condition's last transition.
Producers of specific condition types may define expected values and meanings for this field,
and whether the values are considered a guaranteed API.
The value should be a CamelCase string.
This field may not be empty.

status.description: status of the condition, one of True, False, Unknown.

type.description: type of condition in CamelCase or in foo.example.com/CamelCase.

namespace.description: Namespace is the actual namespace name managed by this Environment.

observedGeneration.description: ObservedGeneration is the most recent generation observed by the controller.

phase.description: Phase represents the overall environment lifecycle phase.

description:
Environment is the Schema for the environments API.
An Environment represents a single deployment target (e.g., production, staging)
within a Tenant. It manages the namespace, RBAC, NetworkPolicy, and ResourceQuota
for that environment.
